purpose: Freeze an outcome-blind, strict-as-of feature substrate from manually reviewed Evidence Quality v1 annotations before any retrospective model fitting.

policies.availabilitySource: source_documents.metadata.availableAt, availableOn, or archiveCapturedAt; missing/invalid availability still fails closed for historical feature use
policies.semanticDeduplication: one signal per semanticFingerprint + membershipId + billId; repeated captures do not multiply counts
policies.exactBillMapping: prefer matching evidence_items membership_id + bill_id; otherwise resolve only the reviewed claim member name and claim bill identifiers by unique exact match in the source session/chamber; never invent or infer a bill identifier
policies.memberIssuePolicy: member_issue evidence remains bill-free; membership may be resolved by unique exact reviewed member identity in the source session/chamber, with no bill inference

correction.reason: Pre-modeling deterministic identity-resolution correction: some reviewed exact member+bill claims were explicit in the annotation but the underlying evidence_items rows did not carry both membership_id and bill_id. Resolve only those already-reviewed claim identities to database IDs by unique exact match within the source legislative session/chamber. No new member, bill, stance, topic, or linkage is inferred.
failClosedRules: claim must already contain exactly one explicit member name for fallback membership resolution
bill IDs are resolved only from bill identifiers already present in the reviewed claim
source chamber is enforced when present
membership/bill database match must be unique
